title: C#: Rewrite trampoline lambdas as static functions
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Fixes build server failure for Windows. The build failure output was as follows:
<details>
<summary>Error output</summary>

```log
modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp: In static member function 'static void CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)':
modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2444:25: error: invalid user-defined conversion from 'CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)>' to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddMethod' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)'}
 2444 |                         try_add_method_tramp, try_add_property_tramp, try_add_raise_signal_tramp);
      |                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  • candidate is: 'constexpr CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)>::operator void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)() const' (near match)
    modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2386:37:
     2386 |         auto try_add_method_tramp = [](CSharpScript *p_scr, const StringName *p_name, int32_t p_argc,
          |                                     ^
    • no known conversion from 'void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)' {aka 'void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)'} to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddMethod' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::MethodTrampoline, bool)'}
modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2444:47: error: invalid user-defined conversion from 'CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)>' to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddProperty' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)'} [-fpermissive]
 2444 |                         try_add_method_tramp, try_add_property_tramp, try_add_raise_signal_tramp);
      |                                               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  • candidate is: 'constexpr CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)>::operator void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)() const' (near match)
    modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2411:39:
     2411 |         auto try_add_property_tramp = [](CSharpScript *p_scr, const StringName *p_name,
          |                                       ^
    • no known conversion from 'void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)' to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddProperty' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, godotsharp::PropertyGetterTrampoline, godotsharp::PropertySetterTrampoline)'}
modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2444:71: error: invalid user-defined conversion from 'CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)>' to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddRaiseSignal' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)'} [-fpermissive]
 2444 |                         try_add_method_tramp, try_add_property_tramp, try_add_raise_signal_tramp);
      |                                                                       ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  • candidate is: 'constexpr CSharpScript::update_script_class_info(Ref<CSharpScript>)::<lambda(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)>::operator void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)() const' (near match)
    modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:2434:43:
     2434 |         auto try_add_raise_signal_tramp = [](CSharpScript *p_scr, const StringName *p_name, int32_t p_argc,
          |                                           ^
    • no known conversion from 'void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int32_t, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)' {aka 'void (*)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)'} to 'GDMonoCache::ManagedCallbacks::Callback_ScriptManagerBridge_UpdateScriptTrampolines_TryAddRaiseSignal' {aka 'void (__attribute__((stdcall)) *)(CSharpScript*, const StringName*, int, godotsharp::RaiseSignalTrampoline)'}
```
</details>

The only difference between these function pointers is the presence/absence of the `stdcall` attribute. By using static functions instead, the attribute should persist as expected. Adopts the same logic used by #65533, just for the trampoline lambdas

## Additional information

No clue *why* this started being an issue only now, but hey
